label: Week 34, 2026
recap:
This was a quiet week for United States AI policy and litigation. Between August 17 and August 23, 2026, the tracked activity amounted to one bill movement, two case updates, and one federal document. The bill activity was confined to a single jurisdiction, California, where one bill's status changed. Of the bills tracked, one touched on the Government use theme, covering how agencies buy, deploy, and account for AI, including inventories and procurement rules, while one bill did not fall under any specific theme. The California's Civil Rights Commission was noted as an agency of interest in this period.

On the litigation side, two case updates were recorded during the week, though no jurisdictional or thematic detail was available for them. Overall, with only a handful of items across bills, cases, and federal documents, this week reflected limited movement rather than any broad legislative or judicial push, with California standing as the only jurisdiction showing recorded bill activity.
